sources_used: web search UK seaside / FEC arcade inventories

findings.name: Cineworld Dundee
findings.evidence_quote: Small place with very few games. May as well buy a ticket. Games listed: Time Crisis 4, Stacker, Hockey Table only.
findings.note: Cinema lobby FEC with only 3 non-music cabs logged. Inventory old (2019) but venue type and size make tracked rhythm cabs very unlikely. No newer music-game reports found.

findings.name: Cineworld Yeovil
findings.evidence_quote: All there is now at Cineworld is only one arcade game. Games: Mario Kart Arcade GP 2; Claw Machine (Maxx Grab).
findings.note: Explicit ZIv note that only one arcade game remains (plus claw). No music games.

findings.name: Circus Circus
findings.evidence_quote: Games listed: Minecraft Dungeons Arcade only (near Stacker). No music games section.
findings.note: Great Yarmouth seaside arcade. ZIv inventory incomplete (only one cab logged). No positive proof of absence of rhythm games.

findings.name: Clambers
findings.evidence_quote: Children's play centre with a few claw machines. No games of note. Games: Claw Machine only.
findings.note: Soft-play centre (clambers.co.uk), not a music arcade. Positive ZIv statement of no games of note plus claw-only listing. Still operating as soft play.

findings.name: Cofton park holidays
findings.evidence_quote: Holiday park that's fully open to the public. No DDR when visited, but had a SW battle pod and other main cabs that would make me expect they could get something at some point.
findings.note: Visitor noted no DDR on one visit; ZIv lists no games. Incomplete inventory and 2022 date - not strong enough for confirmed_none.

findings.name: Coghurst Caravan Park
findings.evidence_quote: Caravan Park with small arcade, nothing special. Games: Animal Kaiser; Dead Heat (2P); Claw Machine x2; Flying Tickets; Spongebob Squarepants Pineapple Arcade Pusher.
findings.note: Small holiday-park clubhouse inventory is all racing/redemption/claws. Dated 2019; confidence only likely.

findings.name: Coin casino
findings.evidence_quote: By the water has many 2p machines and a few modern ticket games and some 18+ slot machines. It was called coin casino but now just says Amusements on the front.
findings.note: UK coin/pusher/slots amusement arcade (Bowness). Positive description of 2p/ticket/slot mix only; no video music games.

findings.name: Coney Island
findings.evidence_quote: Music Game: 舞战纪 (Dance Battle) (China). Comment: Very interesting DanceRush Stardom clone, the most expensive dance game in Scarborough. The capacitive pad is sensitive enough and feels great to play. Price: £2.00 for 1 song.
findings.note: Chinese Dance Battle cab is a DRS-style pad game, not official Konami DRS. Mapped to other (not drs/dance_around). Comment from StaticFish ~10 months before fetch still discussing the cab.

findings.name: Continue?
findings.evidence_quote: From retro classics like Pac-Man and Space Invaders to modern favorites such as Dance Dance Revolution and racing simulators, every corner of our arcade is designed to evoke nostalgia and excitement.
findings.note: Continue Arcades free-play lounge Taunton (36-38 East St). Visit Somerset and dayoutwiththekids list DDR; site image alt text also references Dance Dance Revolution. ZIv has empty games list. No cabinet count. Do not trust unrelated Facebook snippets listing full Bemani fleets (IIDX/SDVX/jubeat) without local corroboration.

findings.name: Crealy Theme Park & Resort
findings.evidence_quote: Although this is mainly a Theme Park, there is an arcade inside the Atlantis area. Games: Phantom Motorcycle; Barrel of Monkeys; Claw Machine; Crank It!; Spinner Frenzy; Whack-A-Clown.
findings.note: Theme-park redemption arcade inventory only; no music games logged.

findings.name: Derwent Amusements
findings.evidence_quote: Games: No games at this location. Old comment: The Screen is in BAD shape and just about to see screen when playing.
findings.note: Matlock Bath seaside arcade. Empty ZIv music list and no recent public inventory found. Unknown, not confirmed_none.

findings.name: Dimes
findings.evidence_quote: One of many arcades along Barry Island. All mainly having predominantly redemption games. Games: 007 James Bond (Stern); Super Bikes; Aliens Armageddon; Deal or No Deal.
findings.note: Barry Island redemption-focused arcade. Listed cabs are pinball/racing/shooter/redemption only.

findings.name: Downtown Amusements
findings.evidence_quote: Games: No games at this location. Website: tirprince.co.uk. Address Towyn Road, Towyn.
findings.note: Towyn/Tir Prince area amusement arcade. ZIv empty and stale; no reliable public music-game inventory found.

findings.name: Drayton Manor Hotel
findings.evidence_quote: This is mainly a hotel, but there is a arcade within. Games: Go Go Pony; Despicable Me Minion Whacker; Duo Drive.
findings.note: Small hotel arcade; only kiddie/redemption cabs listed.

findings.name: Drayton Manor- Neptune's Amusements
findings.evidence_quote: A fair few games in the arcade in the theme park mostly redemption. Games: Men In Black; Bop It Arcade; Chupa Chups Skill; Claw Machine; Down The Clown; Fireball; Milk Jug Toss; Monopoly Roll Down; Slam-A-Winner; Whack-A-Clown.
findings.note: Theme-park redemption arcade; no music games in inventory.

findings.name: Dreamland Margate
findings.evidence_quote: This arcade has really changed a few years, and is mostly redemption. Games: Pac-Man Battle Royale; Phantom Motorcycle; Luigi's Mansion Arcade; House of the Dead Scarlet Dawn; Transformers Shadows Rising; claws/pushers; Mario & Sonic Olympic 2020.
findings.note: Mostly redemption noted, but inventory not proven exhaustive and dated 2022. No music games reported; still unknown rather than confirmed_none.

findings.name: Dunes Amusement Arcade
findings.evidence_quote: This is a bit of a mystery arcade, with a few games that might not fit. Long non-music list: Dead Heat, MotoGP, Barbercut, claws, Dizzy Chicken, Down The Clown, Ice Man, Monster Drop, Pac-Man Swirl/Smash, Slam-A-Winner, Sonic Blast Ball, Wizard of Oz pushers.
findings.note: Fairly long ZIv list with zero music games, but ZIv itself calls it a mystery arcade. Treat as unknown.

findings.name: Dutchy's Tavern
findings.evidence_quote: Games: Sega Touring Car Championship only (Not Working; calibration/monitor issues).
findings.note: California Sands / Great Yarmouth area. Only a broken racer logged; incomplete inventory.

findings.name: Eastbourne Pier
findings.evidence_quote: A new arcade has been added! It's a massive improvement... nowhere near as good as the one that burned down. Games listed are all redemption/sports (Alley Ooop, Angry Birds Whacker, Skeeball, Slam-A-Winner, Virtual Rabbids, basketballs, etc.). Comment: Euromix is already dead?
findings.note: Historic DDR Euromix gone (old comments). Current logged floor is redemption/skill only. Confidence likely not certain (pier may have other rooms).

findings.name: Electric Thrill
findings.evidence_quote: Games: Mario Kart Arcade GP 2; After Burner Climax (Super Deluxe Cab). Venue also markets mini golf, pool, diner, retro classics (Ms Pac-Man, Galaga, etc.).
findings.note: East Kilbride FEC/mini-golf. ZIv only logs 2 cabs; social posts mention more retro. No rhythm games found, inventory incomplete.

findings.name: Enterprise Amusements
findings.evidence_quote: Update (July 2014): There are no DDR machines at this location any more. Games: No games at this location.
findings.note: Positive 2014 note that DDR was removed, but 12 years old with empty inventory since. Paignton seafront arcade may have changed; cannot treat 2014 as current confirmed_none.

findings.name: Exmouth Amusements
findings.evidence_quote: Games: No games at this location. Picture on page titled Exmouth Amusements - 5thMIX (historical DDR cabinet photo).
findings.note: Historical DDR 5thMIX photo remains on ZIv; current games list empty and page stale. Status of any music cab unknown.

findings.name: Fairworld Amusements
findings.evidence_quote: Just a bunch of redemption games and slot machines at this point. No real reason to visit unless you have... some serious nostalgia for the ol' Tuppenny Nudger. Comment StaticFish 1 year ago: Not much here any more, mostly games focused on kids. Older comments: RIP Extreme / DDR Extreme removed.
findings.note: Cleethorpes. Explicit ZIv description of redemption/slots only; historical DDR Extreme removed years ago; recent visitor confirms kids/redemption focus.

findings.name: Fantasy Island
findings.evidence_quote: Music Game: Guitar Hero Arcade (International). Comment: For some reason, p1 controls p2 and p2 controls p1. The guitars are good enough, but the strum bars aren't the best. They have the volume up and it gives you a credit for just 20p. Price £0.20.
findings.note: Withernsea Fantasy Island (Memorial Avenue). Guitar Hero Arcade is not a tracked Bemani slug; mapped to other. Also had Sega Rally 2 (powered off). No newer removal reports found.

findings.name: Fantasy Island Amusements
findings.evidence_quote: Comment Winteredsoul ~6 months ago: ddr has been gone for months apparently. Games currently listed: Wartran Troopers only. Pictures on page still show A20+ full cabinet/pads (historical). Facebook Fantasy Island Canvey promo: From Mario Kart and Guitar Hero to.
findings.note: Canvey Island. DDR A20+ removed per 2026 ZIv comment (photos remain as historical). Venue FB still advertises Guitar Hero among arcade games; treat as other (unverified whether cabinet still on floor). Do not list ddr.

findings.name: Felixstowe Pier
findings.evidence_quote: Recently got renovated so mostly redemption games, a few VR stuff too though which is pretty cool. Games: Asphalt Moto Blitz DX; Mario Kart Arcade GP DX (4 cabs); Super Bikes 3; Halo Fireteam Raven; Jurassic Park Arcade; Crossy Road Arcade.
findings.note: Recent non-music inventory after renovation; no music games logged. Still not exhaustive enough for certain confirmed_none.

findings.name: Fifth Avenue Amusements Arcade
findings.evidence_quote: Seems like a very friendly place. Mostly contains coin pushers, ticket related games and crane games. Games: No games at this location.
findings.note: Llandudno Mostyn St. Visitor description is positive evidence of pushers/tickets/cranes only.

findings.name: Flamingo Land
findings.evidence_quote: There's quite a few arcades through the park, so I'm just going to class it as one because they all use the same card system. Games: Target Bravo Operation G.H.O.S.T.; Down The Clown; Pop It & Win; Subway Surfers.
findings.note: Multiple park arcades collapsed into one ZIv entry with partial sample list. Cannot confirm full park has no rhythm games.

findings.name: Fletchers Arcade
findings.evidence_quote: Games: No games at this location. External coverage: historic amusement arcade / Joe Joe Jims café bar with retro cabs (Pac-Man, Space Invaders, Defender, etc.).
findings.note: Cofton Hackett retro arcade/bar. No music-game list found online; ZIv empty. Unknown.

findings.name: Flip Out Ashford
findings.evidence_quote: Games: Dead Heat (2P); Super Bikes 2 (2P); Terminator Salvation (Unknown Model). Venue is Flip Out trampoline park chain arcade zone.
findings.note: Trampoline-park FEC. Only racers/shooter logged; chain locations do not carry Bemani. Inventory old; confidence likely.

findings.name: Flip Out Aylesbury
findings.evidence_quote: Just opened, located within the mall. Games: TMNT 2018; World's Largest Pac-Man; Dead Heat (2P); MotoGP Arcade; X Games Snowboarder; Candy Crush Saga; Fruit Ninja FX; NERF Arcade; Rabbids & Ladders.
findings.note: Mall Flip Out FEC. Fairly broad non-music list; no rhythm cabs.

findings.name: Flip Out Doncaster
findings.evidence_quote: Games: Dirty Drivin'; Showdown (2P); Luigi's Mansion Arcade; Target Bravo Operation G.H.O.S.T.; Sonic Sports Basketball.
findings.note: Flip Out FEC. Non-music inventory only.

findings.name: Folly Farm (adventure playground)
findings.evidence_quote: Previously a DDR euromix with wide-screen mod was here however removed around 2020. Now seems to be mainly small crane games and such.
findings.note: Positive removal note for the only known music cab, plus current crane-only description.

findings.name: Four Quarters East
findings.evidence_quote: Whether it's for Pinball, Tekken, Guitar Hero or Street Fighter, Four Quarters East is more than your average canalside bar. Our arcade machines are the real deal, genuine restored vintage cabinets... We also have bookable Console Booths.
findings.note: Hackney Wick retro bar. Guitar Hero named on official page but may be console-booth rather than arcade cab; ZIv only lists Crazy Taxi upright. Mapped to other, unverified. No Bemani/ALL.Net.

findings.name: Fun City Amusements
findings.evidence_quote: Games: No games at this location. Address 18-22 Pier Road (Whitby seafront).
findings.note: Typical UK pier-front amusement arcade. No public music-game inventory found.

findings.name: Fun Factory 2
findings.evidence_quote: Music Game: Guitar Hero Arcade (International). Location: Near the right entrance. Comment: Right guitar fret frame is snapped on the top. otherwise mint condition. Horrific song select as most songs have been hidden. £1.00 for 1 song. Info: Another Fun Factory, arcade cards from the other Fun Factory can be used here, general redemption and such games.
findings.note: Towyn Fun Factory 2. Guitar Hero Arcade under Music Game on ZIv; slug other. Update mid-2025.

findings.name: Fun Harbour
findings.evidence_quote: General claw machines, coin games, racing games, etc. The downstairs is completely closed and used for storage now. Comment blitzen: the basement doesnt seem to be opening again and just being used for storage, couldnt find ddr or guitar hero so its likely not there anymore or still not available. Floor games: Mario Kart GP 2; OutRun 2 SP; Super Bikes 2; Deal or No Deal; Dracula Pot Of Tickets; Sonic Sports Basketball; Boxer.
findings.note: Barry Island. Visitor actively looked for DDR/Guitar Hero and did not find them; basement storage closed. Recent 2026 page update.

findings.name: Fun Station
findings.evidence_quote: Located on the second floor. Fun Station has games and dodgems while Prize Station is mostly redemption. Long list includes Mario Kart GP DX, Halo Fireteam Raven, Jurassic Park, Super Bikes 3, Grand Piano Tiles, NERF Arcade, etc. No Music Game category entries.
findings.note: Braehead GRID Funstation. Grand Piano Tiles is a piano skill cab but ZIv does not class it as Music Game; not mapped to a valid slug. No Bemani/DDR/Pump found. Inventory may miss cabs - unknown.

findings.name: FunWorks
findings.evidence_quote: Located inside Kiln Park... Typical caravan park arcade with 2p machines and general redemption and such. Games: Typhoon only.
findings.note: Tenby Kiln Park guest-only amusements: 2p pushers/redemption/Typhoon. Positive description of caravan-park mix without music games.
